changes.old: Medium close shot beside a small wooden relief cottage in a 1907 camp, one elderly grey-haired observer with a deeply lined face in a dark high-collared wool coat looks down at a small tied cloth pouch resting on the rough wooden doorstep, the cottage plank doorway fills the background, soft overcast daylight
